session.description: The earth-luna-dtn sky and the earth-mars-hdtn-relay chain in one session. Around Earth and Luna: a polar LEO shell, a GEO relay ring and a cislunar DTN relay vehicle, with QUIC labs and uD3TN endpoints at Tidbinbilla and the lunar south pole. Toward Mars: three Mars bases, low and areostationary Mars relays, an optical trunk across the Earth-Mars light time (338 s one way at the 2027 opposition) to an Earth GEO deep-space relay and two optical ground stations, every relay and endpoint host running NASA HDTN over LTP. The two DTN networks are independent; each Earth relay network reaches its far body through a static boundary.
